items.title: People judge instantly: caps stack with a purple label and a yellow loop
items.note: One look from: Kinetic hook titles.
items.source: Envato Elements: Kinetic Hook Titles by Qwadro

build.recipe: Five-line stack in Anton caps, white with a grey shadow; the middle word on a purple bar in white serif, yellow script 'you.' last, a thin yellow ellipse drawn round the stack (registry hw-callout-circle); lines slam in scale 1.3 to 1, 0.05 s apart.
build.add: New renderer R["hook-judge-stack"] in studio-looks.js, cloned from hook-bars (keep its bar row: bg div scaleX + masked inner text) for the one label line. Slot the hook tokens from ctx.hook(): first short run = small lead (36% of hero size), next word = huge hero, the run before the emphasis = the bar line, the first emphasis word = second huge hero, the last emphasis word = script tail. Port the hw-callout-circle wobbled-ellipse SVG path (stroke-dashoffset draw, same pattern as the retired R["hook-ring"] circle) and sit it UNDER the words (z-index below the text). Add the instant punch from R["move-punch"] (tl.set to a scale, no tween) on G.inner. Dim the footage with H.mediaFX b 0.6 (the gfx-quotecard proxy, no blur) so white reads on the cream tee and curtain. Needs a handwritten font for the VIDPOD script tail, e.g. add Caveat (until then Inter 400 italic); @pilates uses fonts/Tangerine.otf. New board entry via tools/make_vidpod_board.py, recipe via tools/enrich_board.py.

assets.colours: VIDPOD: heroes and lead #FFFFFF Archivo Black (Anton is the board's condensed option if Tommy wants the reference's tall caps), bar #00FFAA with Inter 800 caps #0A0A0A, ellipse 4 px #00FFAA, script tail #00FFAA. @pilates: heroes Sohne Halbfett 700 #FFFFFF, bar #BCA28F with Sohne Buch 300 caps #FFFFFF, ellipse #BCA28F, tail Tangerine #BCA28F.
assets.clip: clients/vidpod/media/base.mp4 (Seated): hook segment 0 to 2.91 s carries "I've been down quite a few *rabbit holes*", which splits cleanly into I'VE BEEN / DOWN / [QUITE A FEW] / RABBIT / holes. (script). Stack sits on the chest, L.y about 1190 (y 880 to 1500), under his chin and inside the safe zone.

build.motion: Measured (25 fps): the line slam-ins happen before the crop, so use a 2 frame (0.08 s) stagger, each line scale 1.3 to 1 over 4 frames (0.16 s) power4.out, on its spoken word (I've 0.176, down 0.514, quite 0.916, rabbit 1.398). Whole stack settles 113% to 100% over 24 frames (0.96 s) sine.out from the first word. Script tail wipes on left to right in 6 frames (0.24 s) power2.out at holes 1.704 s. Ellipse draws 10 frames sine.inOut with the settle (not visible in the crop, proposed). Punch-in: 100% to 116% in 1 frame (tl.set, steps(1)) 20 frames after the script starts (2.40 s), pop.mp3 on it, hold 13 frames (0.52 s), hard cut at the segment end 2.91 s (no fade, the reference cuts).

style.keep: Six-part caps stack with two huge words, one label bar, the ellipse looping behind the middle, the script tail, the slow settle and the one-frame punch.
style.swap: Anton distressed caps to Archivo Black, magenta bar to #00FFAA (@pilates #BCA28F), lime script and ellipse to #00FFAA, the reference copy to the clip's own hook words.

breakdown.onScreen: A centred six-part caps stack on a dark ground: small white condensed caps "PEOPLE", huge white heavy condensed caps "JUDGE" (Anton class, slightly distressed, grey drop shadow), white high-contrast serif caps "INSTANTLY" on a magenta bar (#C42BE0 approx.), small white condensed caps "BEFOR THEY" (spelt that way in the source), huge white "KNOW", then "you." in a lime brush script (#D8F51E approx.). A thin lime ellipse loops round the middle of the stack, sitting behind the words. On a 1080x1920 frame I would set it centred at about 62% width (x 205 to 875), y about 620 to 1250, in front of the person, no matte needed.
breakdown.motion: The stack (PEOPLE, JUDGE, the magenta INSTANTLY bar, BEFOR THEY, KNOW and the lime ellipse) is already on at frame 0 and eases down in scale by about 13% from frame 2 to frame 24. The lime script 'you.' writes on left to right from frame 5 to frame 10. At frame 25 the whole card jumps up to about 116% in a single frame (a punch-in accent), then holds with a tiny drift until the pack cuts away at frame 39.
breakdown.brandMap: VIDPOD: big words in Archivo Black #FFFFFF, the bar word in Inter 800 caps #0A0A0A on a #00FFAA bar, ellipse and closing word in #00FFAA with the closing word in Inter 400 italic (VIDPOD has no script). @pilates: big words Söhne Halbfett 700 #FFFFFF, bar #BCA28F with Söhne Buch 300 caps in #FFFFFF, ellipse #BCA28F and the closing word in Tangerine #BCA28F.
breakdown.build: New build, HOOK. hw-callout-circle for the ellipse draw-on, text-stagger for the line slams, hw-write-title technique for the script word (swap the Caveat glyphs for the brand script). Stack width 62%, line gap 0.05 s, slam 0.25 s power4.out, ellipse 0.4 s sine.inOut, hold 1.0 s.
breakdown.prompt: Build a new HOOK style called "Judge stack" for the VIDPOD board: add an entry in clients/vidpod/board.json via tools/make_vidpod_board.py with recipe fields registry "hw-callout-circle, text-stagger", how "caps stack, label bar, ellipse, script tail", framing "centred, over subject", timings "0.05 s line stagger, 0.25 s slam, 0.4 s ellipse". Renderer in studio-looks-2.js, keyed by style id. Centred stack, 62% width, y 620 to 1250: lead word Inter 800 caps #FFFFFF, two hero words Archivo Black #FFFFFF, label word Inter 800 caps #0A0A0A on a #00FFAA bar, closing word Inter 400 italic #00FFAA. 4 px #00FFAA ellipse behind the text. Lines slam scale 1.3 to 1 power4.out 0.25 s, 0.05 s apart, ellipse draws 0.4 s sine.inOut, closing word wipes on 0.25 s. @pilates swap: Söhne Halbfett 700 for heavy lines, #BCA28F bar and ellipse, Tangerine closing word. Done when it reads at 390x844, nothing passes x 135 to 945, and it loops cleanly.

motion.notes: The line slam-ins happen before this crop starts, so only the settle is visible. The punch-in at frame 25 jumps from 100% to about 116% with no tween. Frames 39 to 44 are empty pack background, so the exit is a hard cut at frame 39.

safe.note: proposed placement, measured from the pack crop and scaled to a hook centred in the top half; inside x 316 to 764, y 250 to 950. After the frame-25 punch-in it grows to about 520 x 812, still inside.

build.recipe: Giant white 'NO' in Anton, 'Clear' in small dark italic on a yellow tape bar tilted across its foot, 'MESSAGE' white on a red block, 'NO RESULT' tiny in a red outline pill; pieces punch in 0.08 s apart. Builds from HOOK-01 Highlight bars with rotated bars.
build.add: New renderer R["hook-tape-stack"] in studio-looks.js extending hook-bars: a giant word (the emphasis word, fitted to 80% of H.maxW), a tape bar (hook-bars' bg div rotated -5 deg, transform-origin centre) carrying the run before it in Inter italic, a block word (the last emphasis run) on a #0A0A0A bar using hook-bars' scaleX wipe, and a small tag (first word) inside an outline-draw style pill (conic-gradient border or SVG rect stroke-dashoffset). One text-shimmer sweep across the giant word. Same H.mediaFX b 0.6 dim as hook-judge-stack.

assets.colours: VIDPOD: giant word #FFFFFF, tape #00FFAA with Inter 400 italic #0A0A0A, block #0A0A0A with Inter 800 caps #FFFFFF, tag outline 2 px #00FFAA. @pilates: giant word Sohne Halbfett 700 #FFFFFF, tape #BCA28F with Sohne Buch 300 italic #FFFFFF, block #423E3E, tag outline #72696B.

Chin is about y 900 after the 7.76 s cut, so the stack sits y 950 to 1500 (L.y about 1225) over the hoodie and mic.

build.motion: Measured: the NO, block and tape entries are before the crop, so each piece lands on its spoken word (maybe 8.184, we 8.426, charging 8.749, for 9.153) with a 2 frame (0.08 s) minimum gap: giant word scale 1.25 to 1 over 4 frames power4.out, tape back.out(2) 4 frames, block scaleX 0 to 1 over 5 frames power4.out (hook-bars wipe). Whole card drifts 106% to 100% linearly (ease none) over 39 frames (1.56 s) from 8.75 s. Tag outline draws 18 frames (0.72 s) sine.inOut from 9.15 s (10 frames after charging), starting at its left end and closing on the right; shimmer.mp3 under the shimmer pass at 9.15 s. Hold 11 frames, hard cut at 10.34 s.

style.keep: Giant word with a tilted tape across its foot, a solid block word overlapping its base, a small outlined tag, the slow linear drift and the late outline draw.
style.swap: Lime-yellow tape to #00FFAA, red block to #0A0A0A, red ellipse to #00FFAA (@pilates #BCA28F / #423E3E / #72696B), silver sheen to one text-shimmer pass, copy to the clip's hook words.

breakdown.onScreen: A giant white "NO" in heavy condensed sans caps (about 55% of frame width) with a soft silver gradient sheen, a small lime-yellow tape (#E6F51A approx.) tilted about -5 degrees across the foot of the "O" carrying "Clear" in small dark italic sans (#1A1A1A), "MESSAGE" in white condensed caps on a red block (#D8222A approx.) overlapping the base of "NO", and "NO RESULT" in tiny white italic caps inside a thin red ellipse outline. On 1080x1920 I would centre it at x 540, y about 600 to 1250, in front of the person, no matte.
breakdown.motion: Everything (giant NO, the tilted yellow 'Clear' tape, the red MESSAGE block and 'NO RESULT') is already on at frame 0 and the whole card shrinks slowly by about 6% across the clip. The thin red ellipse round 'NO RESULT' draws on from frame 10 to frame 27, starting at its left end and closing on the right. It holds until the pack preview cuts at frame 39.
breakdown.brandMap: VIDPOD: "NO" in Archivo Black #FFFFFF, tape #00FFAA with Inter 400 italic #0A0A0A, the block word Inter 800 caps #FFFFFF on #0A0A0A with a #00FFAA outline round the small tag. @pilates: "NO" in Söhne Halbfett 700 #FFFFFF, tape #BCA28F with Söhne Buch 300 italic #FFFFFF, block #423E3E, small tag outline #72696B.
breakdown.build: New build, HOOK (extends HOOK-01 Highlight bars with a rotated tape). outline-draw for the tag outline, text-shimmer for the sheen on the giant word, inline-highlight for the block wipe. Giant word 55% width, tape rotate -5 degrees, entries 0.08 s apart, outline draw 0.375 s.

items.title: The game is won: a big green number that counts up
items.note: One look from: Kinetic hook titles.
items.source: Envato Elements: Kinetic Hook Titles by Qwadro

build.recipe: GFX-02 Rolling number styled as a hook: grey 'THE GAME' caps with a yellow tape label, small 'IS WON', a giant green number counting up to 99 with a small %, white caption chip under.
build.add: New renderer R["gfx-count-hook"] in studio-looks-2.js next to gfx-roll, reading the same words_extra.roll fields (from, to, before, after) but counting a GSAP proxy with Math.round per frame instead of gfx-roll's digit strips, so at 25 fps the values step every frame like the reference. Stack above the number: small lead (cut on), larger #6B6B6B word with a tape label sliding in, small connector, then the number with a prefix/suffix span, and a white chip under it. Use the gfx-quotecard footage treatment (H.mediaFX b 0.5, blur 16, 0.5 s sine.inOut in, 0.45 s out) so the stat card reads over the walk. Add words_extra.roll for rooftop-walk: from 0, to 5000, prefix "$".

assets.colours: VIDPOD: lead Inter 800 caps #FFFFFF, second word #6B6B6B with a #00FFAA tape and #0A0A0A text, number and prefix Archivo Black #00FFAA, chip #FFFFFF with Inter 800 caps #0A0A0A. @pilates: Sohne Halbfett 700 #FFFFFF, number #BCA28F, tape #BCA28F, chip #F5F5F2 with Sohne Buch 300 #423E3E.
assets.clip: clients/vidpod/media/clips/rooftop-walk/base.mp4 (Rooftop walk): graphics segment 0 to 6 s contains "my dad bought a block of land for $5,000" (land 5.129, $5,000 at 5.533 s), a real number to count to. Stack: MY DAD / BOUGHT (tape "IN THE '70s") / A BLOCK OF LAND FOR / $5,000 / chip COLORADO, USA, centred y 560 to 1300 over the dimmed, softened footage.

build.motion: Measured, anchored so the count lands on the spoken $5,000 (frame 21 = 5.533 s, frame 0 = 4.693 s): lead and second word slide down 105 px over 6 frames (0.24 s) power3.out at frame 5 (4.89 s); small lead cuts on at frame 7; number blur-in (soft-blur-in, 6 px blur to 0) and count 0 to 5,000 over frames 7 to 21 (15 frames, 0.6 s) on expo.out with per-frame rounding so it slows into 4,900, 4,950, 5,000; prefix shows from the start (the reference % cuts on at frame 18, 3 frames before landing); tape slides in from the right 170 px over 3 frames power4.out at frame 18; chip pops at frame 23 in 1 frame (tl.set, pop.mp3). Hold 16 frames, then hold on to the phrase end before "in" 6.68 s and hard cut. riser.mp3 under the count.

style.keep: Caps lead, a grey second word with a small tilted tape label, one giant counting number with a smaller unit, a white chip under it, the stepped (not smooth) count.
style.swap: Lime-to-yellow gradient number to solid #00FFAA (@pilates #BCA28F), the 99% to the clip's $5,000, reference copy to the clip's own words.

breakdown.onScreen: A centred stack: small white condensed caps "THE", large grey-white condensed caps "GAME" with a small lime tape label tilted across it (its tiny dark text is unreadable at this size), small white caps "IS WON", then a giant lime-to-yellow gradient number "99" (#C6F01E to #F0F53A approx.) about 45% of frame width with a smaller lime "%" to its right, and a small white rectangular chip under it with tiny dark caps. On 1080x1920 I would centre it at y about 560 to 1300, in front of the person, no matte.
breakdown.motion: 'GAME' and 'IS WON' are on at frame 0; from frame 5 to frame 10 the stack slides down to recentre as 'THE' cuts on and the number blurs in at frame 7. The number counts 4, 9, 2, 50, 78, 90, 95, 97, 98 and lands on 99 at frame 21, changing every one or two frames and slowing at the end. The '%' cuts on at frame 18, the lime tape label slides in from the right over 'GAME' from frame 18 to 20, and the white chip pops on at frame 23. It holds until the cut at frame 39.
breakdown.brandMap: VIDPOD: lead words Inter 800 caps #FFFFFF and #6B6B6B, number and % in Archivo Black #00FFAA, tape #00FFAA with #0A0A0A text, chip #FFFFFF with Inter 800 #0A0A0A. @pilates: lead words Söhne Halbfett 700 #FFFFFF, number Söhne Halbfett 700 #BCA28F, tape and chip #F5F5F2 style light on #423E3E with Söhne Buch 300 #423E3E.
breakdown.build: GFX-02 Rolling number, restyled as a hook. count-up (or number-wheel) for the number, badge-pop for the chip, the tape as a rotated div. Number 45% width, count 0.25 s to 0.875 s expo.out with 6 px blur while moving, chip pop 0.15 s back.out(2).

build.recipe: SUB-04 Karaoke dim with the reference stack: small 'to' above a big lime key word, next words dimmed until spoken; add the small line icon (paper plane) that flies in on the key word.
build.renderer: studio-looks.js R["cap-karaoke"] (dim-to-lit logic) with the R["hook-mixed"] stack layout (HOOK-02)
build.add: New renderer R["cap-karaoke-stack"] in studio-looks.js plus a SUB style entry in clients/vidpod/board.json via tools/make_vidpod_board.py (recipe text via tools/enrich_board.py). Take hook-mixed's three-row stack (small lead row, huge hero word, small follow row right-aligned) and run it per caption phrase through capBuild with cap-karaoke's dim: waiting words sit at #6B6B6B and 0.4 opacity (cap-karaoke uses 0.35 white) and light on their words.json time. Replace hook-mixed's hero entry (scale 1.12 plus blur 8 px, 0.2 s expo.out) with the measured hard cut on and slow creep, and tune its glow from 34 px at 60% to 24 px at 40%. Cap the hero at 810 px wide (hook-mixed caps at 960) so the measured overflow (x 100 to 1010) comes inside the safe box x 135 to 945. Paper plane: no icon asset exists, so draw an inline SVG outline plane (72 px, 4 px stroke, no fill) and fly it with the arc-motion-path GSAP MotionPath pattern with autoRotate; offset-path-traveler (CSS offset-path) is the fallback if MotionPath is not loaded in the studio.

'your': frame 14, opacity 0.4 to 1 and #6B6B6B to #FFFFFF over 4 frames (0.16 s) sine.out. 'value': frame 17, opacity 0.4 to 1 and #6B6B6B to #00FFAA over 7 frames (0.28 s) sine.out. build.recipe: Each line set on an SVG textPath along a gentle arc (radius about 900 px) so the words bend around the subject, Playfair Display about 90 px white; lines fade in 0.3 s, 0.08 s apart. Not in the studio yet (curved text is on the TEMPLATE-PACKS gap list).
build.renderer: studio-looks.js R["hook-ring"] (retired; reuse its full-frame SVG overlay and base.face geometry)
build.add: New renderer R["hook-curved"] in studio-looks.js with a HOOK style entry via tools/make_vidpod_board.py (curved text is MISSING on TEMPLATE-PACKS.md). Reuse hook-ring's SVG set-up (viewBox 0 0 1080 1920, read of ctx.B.base.face x/y/r) and for each wrapped line add a <path> arc plus <text><textPath startOffset=50% text-anchor=middle>: lines above the face centre on convex arcs, lines below on concave arcs, radius about 900 px, centred on face.x. textPath bends the baseline but does not swell the letters, so get the measured bulge from line sizes (outer 70 to 90 px, middle 150 px). hw-path-text is only the reference for the path-driven per-character set-up; its Caveat handwriting is not used. No bend tween: the reference is static.

build.add: New renderer R["lt-solid-outline"], centred (ltGrp with L.align centre): accent ring icon on top, first name in Archivo Black 96 px filled with a #FFFFFF to #6B6B6B top-to-bottom gradient (background-clip:text, color transparent), surname in Archivo Black 120 px with transparent fill and a 2 px accent -webkit-text-stroke overlapping the lower 40% of the first name, base.role in Inter 800 18 px #0A0A0A on a small #FFFFFF tag (8 px 14 px padding) below. The exit is staged, not a bar burst, so chromatic-aberration-wipe is not used; ltGlitch handles the tag and first-name erase and the surname gets a 1-frame skew snap (skewX(-15deg) rotate(-4deg)) then a squash. Name split helper: base.name split on the first space into two lines ("Tommy Jackett" to TOMMY / JACKETT); a one-word name (@pilates "Alisha") falls back to name on line 1 and base.role on line 2. Shared helper, built once for the whole P18 family: ltGlitch(tl, spans, dir, at, perLetterFrames) porting registry rgb-glitch-text (two absolutely placed copies of each letter offset 6 px, coloured accent and #6B6B6B, shown for 1 frame then the letter is set to opacity 0, ease steps(1)), and ltBars(tl, box, at, dir) porting registry chromatic-aberration-wipe (3 to 5 stacked bars in accent, #FFFFFF, #6B6B6B cut in for 1 frame, hold 4 frames, retract by clip-path inset over 12 frames). New renderer goes in studio-looks.js beside the lt-* family so it can reuse the scoped helpers ltT (t0 = base.name_at, out = seg end minus 0.75 s), ltGrp, ltAcc and ltTxt; option entry added via tools/make_vidpod_board.py (VIDPOD) and clients/atpilates/board.json, recipe text via tools/enrich_board.py.

build.recipe: First name heavy italic white, a small outlined pill with the role, then the surname in outline italic caps.
build.add: New renderer R["lt-italic-pill-glitch"] in studio-looks.js beside R["lt-accent-underline"] (it must live in studio-looks.js to reuse the file-local ltT, ltGrp, ltTxt helpers). Column layout from lt-accent-underline, but the drawn rule becomes row two: an outline pill (2 px accent border, 14 px radius, role in caps, the kicker chip from the local adaptation hyperframes/caption-hook-library/registry/adapted/lt-kicker-name.html) followed by the surname as outline only (-webkit-text-stroke 2px, transparent fill). Both names skewX(-10deg) because Archivo Black has no italic. Shared helper glitchName(tl, rows, at, o) added once in studio-looks.js next to ltT/ltGrp (all six P18 names call it): splits each row into per-letter spans with two offset copies (red/cyan at 6 px, rgb-glitch-text pattern), drops letters with tl.set on a fixed frame stagger in the given direction, then swaps the rows for a 5-colour bar block that jumps right one step per frame and collapses to a 4 px sliver (chromatic-aberration-wipe pattern). Entry calls the same helper on a reversed timeline. Board entry in clients/vidpod/board.json via tools/make_vidpod_board.py (section name), recipe text via tools/enrich_board.py; @pilates entry in clients/atpilates/board.json.

build.add: New renderer R["gfx-head-ring-pill"] in studio-looks.js built from R["hook-ring"], which already draws an SVG circle on ctx.B.base.face (dashoffset 1 to 0, 0.5 s power2.inOut) with an accent glow and a pill tag. Changes: (1) put ring and pill in one wrapper whose scale matches a whole-frame zoom-out done with H.mediaFX (the same media transform R["move-punch"] uses), transform-origin on the face centre, so the ring stays locked to the head; (2) pill grows scaleX from its left edge with no overshoot instead of back.out(1.6) scale; (3) pill text types per character (typewriter, cursor off); (4) headline words fade on their words.json times and move to the Chest snap (y 1150), because the reference's top position (y 140 to 330) is outside the safe top (250) and would hit the ring. Registry entry in the graphics section via tools/make_vidpod_board.py. Ring radius 1.15 x face.r.

assets.colours: VIDPOD: ring #FFFFFF with #00FFAA glow (hook-ring's existing drop-shadow), pill #00FFAA with #0A0A0A Inter 800 text, headline #FFFFFF Inter 800 with key words Archivo Black #00FFAA fading up from #6B6B6B. @pilates: ring #FFFFFF with #BCA28F glow, pill #BCA28F with #FFFFFF Sohne Halbfett, key words #BCA28F.
assets.clip: clients/vidpod/media/clips/rooftop-mic/base.mp4 (Mic in hand): face box x 536, y 605, r 280 held from 2.0 s (camera still arcing before that), chin y 845, so a 322 px ring spans y 283 to 927 and the pill fits at its upper right inside x 945. Seated's face (y 490, r 380, hair top 148) pushes the ring off the top. Start at 2.0 s.

build.motion: Measured (43 frames): whole frame (footage, ring, text) zooms from 142% to 100%; ring diameter progress 0.40 / 0.71 / 0.86 / 0.93 at frames 4 / 10 / 16 / 22, still creeping at 42. power4.out over 42 frames (1.68 s) gives 0.33 / 0.66 / 0.85 / 0.95, the closest standard ease (the extended-keyframe never-quite-lands shape). Ring is on from frame 0 and holds 43 frames; if it needs an entry, keep hook-ring's 0.5 s power2.inOut draw before the zoom. Headline words fade 3 frames (0.12 s, power1.out) each on the spoken word (source starts 3, 5, 12, 15, 25, 28, i.e. on words.json t, no fixed stagger). Pill scaleX 0 to 1 from the ring edge over 4 frames (0.16 s, power3.out, no overshoot) at frame 16 (0.64 s), pop.mp3 there; text types from frame 18 at 2 frames (0.08 s) per character, linear, still typing at loop end. Exit: hook-ring's holdOut (0.24 s power2.in at segment end).

style.keep: Thin glowing ring locked to the head, small tag pill growing out of the ring edge with typed text, fast-start zoom-out of the whole frame, words fading on as spoken.
style.swap: Warm cream ring and salmon pill to white ring with brand-accent glow and accent pill; lime key words to #00FFAA (#BCA28F); heavy dark vignette dropped; headline moved below the ring to stay in safe; copy from his words (pill from base.hook_label or a short line from words.json).

breakdown.onScreen: Talking head under a heavy dark vignette. A thin glowing ring (about 4 px, #FFF4D6 approx with a warm soft glow about 12 px) circles her head, about 61% of frame width, centred on the face at roughly y 770. A small salmon pill (#C9776F approx, white text, slight drop shadow) sits on the ring's upper right edge at about x 650 to 960, y 470, holding a typed line starting 'Please turn...'. Up top, centred at y 140 to 330, a hook in bold geometric sans: 'being on' small white lowercase, 'Camera Stresses' larger in lime #C8F04B, then 'you' white and 'out' lime on a third line. All overlays sit in front of the person, no matte; the ring tracks the head.
breakdown.motion: The ring is already on at frame 0 and tracks the head, and the whole frame (footage, ring and text together) zooms out from about 142% to 100% with a fast start, mostly done by frame 16 and still creeping at frame 42. Headline words fade in over about 3 frames on the spoken word: being 3, on 5, Camera 12, Stresses 15, you 25, out 28, with the lime words fading up from grey. The salmon pill grows out of the ring edge to the right over frames 16 to 19, and its text types on from frame 18 to the end of the clip.
breakdown.brandMap: VIDPOD: ring #FFFFFF with a #00FFAA glow, pill #00FFAA with Inter 800 #0A0A0A text, headline Inter 800 white lead words with key words in Archivo Black #00FFAA. @pilates: ring #FFFFFF with a #BCA28F glow, pill #BCA28F with Söhne Halbfett #FFFFFF, headline Söhne Buch 300 white with key words in Söhne Halbfett 700 #BCA28F.
breakdown.build: New build, GFX. Start from the existing R['hook-ring'] renderer in studio-looks.js (HOOK-09 focus ring, uses the clip's face box), add outline-draw for the ring draw-on, spring-pop for the pill and typewriter for its text, staggered-fade-up for the headline. Key params: ring diameter 1.25x face box, 4 px stroke, glow 12 px, draw 0.5 s power2.inOut, pill pop 0.15 s back.out(1.7), type 0.05 s per letter.
breakdown.prompt: Add a GFX style 'gfx-head-ring-pill' to VidPod Studio. For VIDPOD, add it to clients/vidpod/board.json with tools/make_vidpod_board.py and write the renderer in studio-looks.js keyed by that id, reusing the R['hook-ring'] face-box code. Recipe: registry outline-draw, spring-pop, typewriter, staggered-fade-up; how: glowing ring round the head, pill pops on its edge, hook builds word by word; framing: ring centred on the face box at 1.25x its size, pill at the ring's upper right inside x 945, headline centred y 140 to 330; timings: ring draws clockwise 0 to 0.5 s power2.inOut, headline words 0.12 s apart from 0.2 s power2.out, pill scaleX from left at 0.75 s back.out(1.7) 0.15 s, text types 0.05 s per letter. Ring 4 px #FFFFFF, glow 12 px #00FFAA; pill #00FFAA, Inter 800 30 px #0A0A0A; headline Inter 800 white, key words Archivo Black #00FFAA. In front of footage. For @pilates use Söhne and #BCA28F. Done when it fits 390x844 inside x 135 to 945 and loops cleanly.

motion.notes: The ring's own entry happened before the clip starts. Word starts are timed to speech (3, 5, 12, 15, 25, 28), so staggerFrames is null. The zoom keeps easing after frame 20 (ring diameter 235, 207, 185, 175, 170, 165 px on the 270 px source at frames 0, 4, 10, 16, 22, 42), which is why the headline drifts down. Typing is still running at the last frame.

build.recipe: Carousel cover: 4-line headline alternating Playfair italic and Inter 700 at the same cap height, centred; a handwritten note circled with a drawn arrow (registry hw-callout-circle + hw-arrow); calm full-bleed photo, small handle at the bottom.

Four headline lines via staggered-fade-up, the circled note via hw-callout-circle (ellipse plus handwritten label), the arrow via hw-arrow in the swoop pose. Needs a handwritten font, e.g. add Caveat, for the note (the hw-* pieces bake Caveat glyphs). PlayfairDisplay-var is upright only, so a true serif italic would also need an italic file; the brand swap below avoids that.

build.recipe: Title lockup mid-frame: thin outline script word ('Mental') over a giant condensed cream word (Anton about 260 px, 'BREAK'), tiny caps 'DAY' between with two sparkle glyphs; fades and rises in 0.5 s over a lifestyle shot.
build.add: New renderer R["hook-script-over-giant"] in studio-looks.js extending R["hook-mixed"] (small words hanging off one huge word, hero entry opacity, scale 1.12, blur 8 px to sharp, 0.2 s expo.out): stack becomes thin italic word on top, tiny tracked word between two four-point sparkles, giant hero word below; sparkles are inline SVG four-point stars (no registry match for the sparkle glyph); optional rounded 20 px black film-gate border with grain-overlay and vignette as a toggle. Exit becomes a hard cut (tl.set opacity 0) instead of holdOut's 0.24 s fade. Inter has no italic file, so the VIDPOD script word is Inter 400 skewX(-12deg); @pilates uses Tangerine.otf, a natural fit. Board entry in the hook section via tools/make_vidpod_board.py.

assets.colours: VIDPOD: thin word #FFFFFF, tiny word and sparkles #00FFAA, giant word #FFFFFF. @pilates: Tangerine word #FFFFFF, tiny word and sparkles #BCA28F, giant word #FFFFFF.

build.motion: Measured: no entry visible, the lockup and sparkles are fully on at frame 0 and hold dead still for 65 frames (2.6 s), no sparkle twinkle; exit is a hard cut at frame 65 (0 frames) with the footage cut. Our params: entry not measurable, so keep hook-mixed's hero entry (0.2 s expo.out) with the thin word on soft-blur-in (blur 8 px to 0, 8 frames, 0.32 s, power2.out, +2 frames) and the tiny word plus sparkles fading 4 frames at +6; then hold still to the segment end (2.91 s on Seated) and cut out with tl.set, no fade. The trailing line gets letter-spacing 0.2em. Cards and labels never move. Serif option: Playfair Display is upright only, so for the gold serif italic of the reference add a Playfair Display Italic woff2; do not fake it with skew.

Key phrase: per-letter type-on starting 4 frames after the last lead word, 1 frame (0.04 s) stagger, each letter opacity 0 to 1 over 1 frame, ease none (measured 14 letters over frames 34 to 48). Tail line: per-letter fade 6 frames total (0.24 s), 1 frame stagger, letter-spaced 0.2em (measured frames 60 to 66). Hold about 10 frames (0.4 s) then exit by hard cut, tl.set visibility hidden on the chunk end (capBuild already does this), no fade. Shot change inside the card is a hard cut too.

build.add: New composition hyperframes/compositions/vidpod-sliced-title/ rendered to a 1080x1920 25 fps MP4 title card. Core is slit-scan-reveal: each line is painted as row slices sampled at offset times, so letters smear into slanted ribbons and the offsets collapse to zero as the line lands flat. char-slam-explode is the fallback per-glyph settle if the canvas painter is too heavy (use its reassemble, drop its scatter and shake). Three lines of caps, the top two copies freeze mid-smear and the bottom copy lands clean, as in the still. Block scaled to 92 % so it sits inside x 135 to 945, y up to 1500.
